lines.en: label mayadorm20:
I knock on Maya’s door and wait for her to respond.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Maya 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: : Ah, right on time.
lines.zh: : 啊，来得正好。

lines.en: : Please hold on.
lines.zh: : 请等一下。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay. But what exactly am I holding on for?...
lines.zh: : 呃……好。可我到底要等的是什么？……

lines.en: I hear Maya sifting through a few things in her room before making her way to the door.
lines.zh: 我听见 Maya 在屋里翻找了几样东西，然后才往门口走。

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm1
: It’s less of a matter of you holding {i}on{/i} and more of a matter of you just...holding in general.
lines.zh: : 与其说让你「{i}等一等{/i}」，不如说只是让你……拿一拿。

lines.en: : Here, take this.
lines.zh: : 给，拿着这个。

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm3
Maya hands me a rather curious box and I’m suddenly stricken with intense deja vu.
lines.zh: Maya 递给我一个相当可疑的盒子，我顿时被一阵强烈的似曾相识击中。

lines.en: : What is this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？

lines.en: : Heavy. That’s why you’re holding it.
lines.zh: : 沉。所以才让你拿。

lines.en: : No, I mean...in general.
lines.zh: : 不，我是说……总体来讲。

lines.en: : This isn’t the first time you’ve made me carry a random box in the middle of the night and...that's a strange thing to have a person do multiple times.
lines.zh: : 这已经不是你头一回让我半夜扛着一个莫名其妙的盒子了，而且……这种事被安排给一个人干好几次，就很怪。

lines.en: : And?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？

lines.en: : And I was wondering if you’d tell me what’s in it this time.
lines.zh: : 所以我想知道这次你能不能告诉我里面是什么。

lines.en: : Why would I do that?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要告诉你？

lines.en: : Because we’re best friends?
lines.zh: : 因为我们是最好的朋友？

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm4
: Ew. Don’t even joke about that.
lines.zh: : 恶。连玩笑都别开这种。

lines.en: : If you’re going to gross me out, I’d rather just carry the box there myself.
lines.zh: : 如果你打算恶心我，我宁愿自己把盒子扛过去。

lines.en: : All I did was say we’re best friends. It’s not like I was hitting on you.
lines.zh: : 我就说了句我们是好朋友。又不是我在撩你。

lines.en: : Saying we’re best friends is somehow even worse than hitting on me.
lines.zh: : 说我们是好朋友，不知怎么比撩我还恶心。

lines.en: : How?
lines.zh: : 怎么会？

lines.en: : I don’t know, it just is. Stop it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，反正就是。住口。

lines.en: : So, are we going to the[school] again?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们又要去[school]吗？

lines.en: scene firstmayadorm3
: Yes. Is that a problem?
lines.zh: : 是。有问题吗？

lines.en: : Yes. But only because I have no idea what I'm bringing there.
lines.zh: : 有。但只是因为我不知道我要带去的是什么。

lines.en: : You’ll find out eventually.
lines.zh: : 你迟早会知道的。

lines.en: : I can’t guarantee you’ll be thrilled when you do, though. The answer isn't particularly {i}exciting.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过我不能保证你到时候会觉得兴奋。答案没什么特别{i}刺激{/i}的。

lines.en: : Maya, if there is a watermelon inside of this box, I am going to be very mad.
lines.zh: : Maya，如果这盒子里是个西瓜，我会非常生气。

lines.en: : Why on earth would I ever bring a watermelon {i}away{/i} from me? That doesn't make any sense at all.
lines.zh: : 我到底为什么要把西瓜从我这儿{i}拿开{/i}？那完全说不通。

lines.en: : Your theory is stupid and full of holes.
lines.zh: : 你的理论愚蠢且漏洞百出。

lines.en: : Just tell me what's inside.
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我里面是什么。

lines.en: : Why do you even want to know?
lines.zh: : 你为什么想知道？

lines.en: : You can’t write “Don’t Open” on a box and expect me to not ask things like this.
lines.zh: : 你不能在盒子上写「不要打开」，还指望我不问这种问题。

lines.en: : In fact, pretty much any time there’s a sign telling me {i}not{/i} to do something, I feel compelled to act against it.
lines.zh: : 事实上，基本上只要有块牌子叫我{i}别{/i}干什么，我就有种反着来的冲动。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Question: If I start wearing a shirt that says “Please get to know me” on it, will you finally leave me alone?
lines.zh: : 问一句：如果我开始穿一件写着「请来了解我」的衬衫，你终于肯放过我了吗？

lines.en: : You know, at that point, I think I might have to. That’s an admirable amount of dedication.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，到那份上，我想我可能真的会放过你。那是值得敬佩的执着程度。

lines.en: : I’ll place an order tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚就下单。

lines.en: : Thank you for letting me know beforehand. It was nice knowing you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你提前告诉我。认识你很愉快。

lines.en: : Actually, nevermind. No it wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 其实算了。一点都不愉快。

lines.en: : Can we just take this thing to the[school] now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在能不能把这东西送去[school]了？

lines.en: : I thought you’d never ask.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你永远不会问呢。

lines.en: scene black
Maya and I make our way through the dimly lit streets toward the[school].
lines.zh: Maya 和我穿过灯光昏暗的街道，朝[school]走去。

lines.en: We don’t see anyone else along the way, which is mildly confusing given that it isn’t {i}that{/i} late yet.
lines.zh: 一路上我们没遇到别人，考虑到还不算{i}太晚{/i}，这有点让人不解。

lines.en: But that’s fine, I guess.
lines.zh: 不过没关系吧，我想。

lines.en: Strange things typically seem to happen when I’m with Maya, and a lack of pedestrians isn’t really anywhere near the top of that list.
lines.zh: 跟 Maya 在一起时，怪事总是照常发生，而「没有行人」根本排不上号。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool1
Maya finishes what she came here to do rather quickly.
lines.zh: Maya 很快办完了她来这儿要办的事。

lines.en: She comes out of the classroom and moves directly over to the window, not paying any mind to me.
lines.zh: 她从教室出来，径直走到窗边，完全不理会我。

lines.en: Meanwhile, I’m still trying to figure out exactly what is going on.
lines.zh: 与此同时，我还在努力搞清楚到底在发生什么。

lines.en: What’s so important about delivering a box to[school] in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: 半夜把一个盒子送到[school]，有什么大不了的？

lines.en: And why does she need my help in order to do it?
lines.zh: 而且她为什么需要我帮忙才能做到？

lines.en: Also...why does she treat this like it’s a completely normal thing when it doesn't make any sense whatsoever?
lines.zh: 还有……她为什么把这当成完全正常的事——明明这完全说不通？

lines.en: : Because it {i}is{/i} completely normal.
lines.zh: : 因为它{i}就是{/i}完全正常的。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene mayanightschool2
: You were wondering why I don't see any issue with having you deliver various boxes to school in the middle of the night, weren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你刚才在想「为什么我让你半夜把各种盒子送到学校却完全不觉得有问题」，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...how did you know that?
lines.zh: : 是，可是……你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : You’re easy to read.
lines.zh: : 你很好读。

lines.en: : I know you much better than you think I do.
lines.zh: : 我比你想的还要了解你。

lines.en: : Though, a lot of that is due to how simple-minded and annoying you are.
lines.zh: : 不过，那很大程度上是因为你太一根筋、太烦人。

lines.en: : I don’t really think the {i}annoying{/i} part was necessary or relevant there, but I guess I kind of get it when it comes to the simple-minded part.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得「{i}烦人{/i}」那部分有必要，也没相关性，不过「一根筋」那部分我大概懂。

lines.en: : It’s true that my train of thought isn't exactly packed to the brim with passengers.
lines.zh: : 没错，我的思路列车上乘客确实没挤满。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}就不一样了……

lines.en: scene mayanightschool1
: Yes. I’m frustratingly hard to read, I know.
lines.zh: : 对。我难读到让人抓狂，我知道。

lines.en: : So much so that it eats you up inside.
lines.zh: : 难读到你在心里咬牙切齿。

lines.en: : You wish you could tear the thoughts directly out of my head, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你恨不得把我的想法直接从脑子里撕出来，对吧？

lines.en: : I think that, more than anything, I want you to {i}tell{/i} me about them.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，比起那个，我更想让你亲口{i}告诉{/i}我。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool3
: What a rare response.
lines.zh: : 真是个稀罕的回答。

lines.en: : Was it not to your liking? I can try again if you want.
lines.zh: : 不合你意吗？你要是想，我可以再答一次。

lines.en: : It’s not that. I just expected you to agree with me.
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思。我只是没料到你会赞同我。

lines.en: : You're normally quite irritated with my harshness by the second box.
lines.zh: : 通常到第二个盒子的时候，你就已经被我的严苛惹得很烦了。

lines.en: : There aren’t many occasions where I openly agree with you, so that was probably a fair assumption.
lines.zh: : 我公开赞同你的场合本来就不多，所以你那么猜也合理。

lines.en: : There really aren’t many, are there? The subject of my secrecy is one that you’ve been adamantly against as of late, though.
lines.zh: : 确实不多，是吧？不过，「我的秘密」这个话题可是你近来坚决反对的。

lines.en: : I figured refusing to give in yet again would push you over the edge and make you even more irritating than normal tonight.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为再次拒绝让步会把你逼到临界，让你今晚比平时更烦人。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s definitely frustrating. But there’s no point forcing anyone to do anything they don’t want to do.
lines.zh: : 我是说……确实挺让人窝火的。但逼人做他们不想做的事没有意义。

lines.en: : That’s not true. I forced you to carry something here for nothing in return and I have no regrets whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 不对。我逼你白扛了一个东西来这儿，而我一点后悔都没有。

lines.en: : Sometimes, forcing people to do things they’re not comfortable with is the best way to move them forward.
lines.zh: : 有时候，逼人做他们不舒服的事，反而是推动他们前进的最好办法。

lines.en: : Wouldn't you agree?
lines.zh: : 你不这么认为吗？

lines.en: scene yumi14
scene mayanightschool3
: Not sure.
lines.zh: : 不确定。

lines.en: : Hasn't really come up.
lines.zh: : 没怎么遇到过这种情况。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : I think there’s someone who would be very upset to hear you say that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有个人听到你这么说会非常难过。

lines.en: : There’s always someone upset to hear anything.
lines.zh: : 不管说什么，总会有人难过的。

lines.en: : Agreed.
lines.zh: : 同意。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool1
: Which is why I’ve found it’s best to simply not talk about my deepest thoughts.
lines.zh: : 所以我的结论是：最好别谈我最深的想法。

lines.en: : I’m not good at dealing with people who are hurting. Or upset. Or...people in general, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长应付在痛苦中的人。也不擅长应付难过的人。或者……说到底，应付人这种事本身。

lines.en: : It’s one of the reasons I never come to the graveyard with you.
lines.zh: : 这就是我从来不跟你去墓地的原因之一。

lines.en: scene amiani9
scene mayanightschool1
: Were you close with Ami’s parents?
lines.zh: : 你跟 Ami 的父母亲近吗？

lines.en: : Have you given up on referring to them as your brother and his wife?
lines.zh: : 你已经放弃把他们称作你哥哥和嫂子了吗？

lines.en: : It...still feels a little strange calling them that when I have no idea who either of them are.
lines.zh: : 叫他们「Ami 的父母」……还是有点怪，因为我根本不知道他们是谁。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: Maya pauses and locks her eyes on the stars she loves so much for a moment or two.
lines.zh: Maya 停下来，把目光锁在她最爱的星星上，停留了一两秒。

lines.en: She looks beautiful in the moonlight.
lines.zh: 她在月光下很美。

lines.en: I think about telling her, but know that it will only end in tragedy.
lines.zh: 我想告诉她，但知道那只会以悲剧收场。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool4
: I wasn’t close with them.
lines.zh: : 我跟他们不亲近。

lines.en: : Ami and I didn’t become friends until a later point.
lines.zh: : Ami 和我是到后来才成为朋友的。

lines.en: : Well, then what else is stopping you from coming to their grave? It’s not like you have any sort of attachment or anything.
lines.zh: : 那还有什么拦着你去他们的墓地？你又不是对他们有什么感情什么的。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool5
: That’s a good question.
lines.zh: : 问得好。

lines.en: : What {i}is{/i} stopping me?
lines.zh: : {i}是{/i}什么在拦着我呢？

lines.en: : Do you have an answer? Or are you just being weird and leaving things open-ended for the millionth time?
lines.zh: : 你有答案吗？还是说你又要把事情搁着不答——这已经是第一百万次了。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool4
: Did you expect me to actually answer that?
lines.zh: : 你真指望我会回答那个？

lines.en: : I literally just finished talking about how secretive I am and now you want me to tell you a secret?
lines.zh: : 我刚刚才说完我有多爱保密，现在你又要我告诉你一个秘密？

lines.en: : Just how stupid are you?
lines.zh: : 你到底能有多蠢？

lines.en: : Okay, there’s no need to be rude. I was just asking a question.
lines.zh: : 好吧，没必要这么刻薄。我只是问个问题。

lines.en: : The least you can do after I help you carry {i}another{/i} stupid box here is-
lines.zh: : 我{i}又{/i}帮你扛了一个破盒子到这儿，你至少该——

lines.en: scene mayanightschool6
: Don’t call it stupid.
lines.zh: : 别叫它破盒子。

lines.en: Maya sounds unusually stern.
lines.zh: Maya 的声音异常地严厉。

lines.en: I’ve only seen her this way a few times, and each one has been after I’ve talked too much or asked a few too many questions.
lines.zh: 我只见过她这样几次，每一次都是在我话太多、或者问得太多了之后。

lines.en: And, while it’s true that I may have been doing that again tonight, I feel like this anger is placed elsewhere.
lines.zh: 而且，虽然我今晚可能确实又犯了，但我感觉这份愤怒另有源头。

lines.en: Even if I don’t know what’s in the box, I can surmise that whatever it is must be of some importance to her.
lines.zh: 就算我不知道盒子里是什么，我也能推断出，不管是什么，对她一定很重要。

lines.en: Hooray for the powers of common sense and deductive reasoning.
lines.zh: 为常识和演绎推理的力量欢呼。

lines.en: : My bad. I didn’t mean it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不是那个意思。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool1
: It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: : I can only imagine how frustrating it must be to be forced into a role you never wanted, without any explanation as to why you’re performing it.
lines.zh: : 我可以想象，被迫扮演一个你从没想要、又没人告诉你为什么要演的角色，有多憋屈。

lines.en: : But you did a good job.
lines.zh: : 但你做得很好。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : No need to get sappy. All I did was carry a box.
lines.zh: : 不用这么煽情。我只是扛了个盒子。

lines.en: : You carried a burden. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 你扛的是一个重担。那不一样。

lines.en: : ...I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: scene mayanightschool2
: There’s no hidden meaning in that. I just meant it must have been a burden on you to carry it.
lines.zh: : 那里面没什么弦外之音。我只是说，扛它对你肯定是个负担。

lines.en: : I made you do something you didn’t want to do, and now I must make it up to you.
lines.zh: : 我逼你做了你不想做的事，现在我得补偿你。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t have to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 哦，你不用担心那个。

lines.en: : Just spending time with you is enough to make me happy.
lines.zh: : 光是跟你待在一起就足够让我开心了。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool5
: Heh...
: If only it were that easy.
lines.zh: : 要是真有那么容易就好了。

lines.en: : I know better than most that making you happy takes a lot more effort than just walking to[school] at night and pawning off some fleeting thoughts on you.
lines.zh: : 我比大多数人都清楚：让你开心，可不只是半夜走到[school]、再把一些转瞬即逝的想法倒给你就行。

lines.en: : But thank you for pretending. You’ve always been good at that.
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你装模作样。你一直都很擅长装。

lines.en: scene mayanightschool7
: Now-
lines.zh: : 那么——

lines.en: : How about I treat you to a drink?
lines.zh: : 我请你喝一杯如何？

lines.en: scene mayacg8
scene mayasweep5
scene mayadormten21
scene mayasit2
scene mayayay2
scene reset8
scene mayabeach10
scene vend1
: How is it?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: I crack open the can and take a sip.
lines.zh: 我拉开拉环，喝了一口。

lines.en: It’s a sort of semi-sweetened iced coffee that causes a wave of nostalgia to sweep over me as I press my back against the cold alley wall.
lines.zh: 那是一种微甜的冰咖啡，当我的背靠上冰冷的小巷墙壁时，一股怀旧感席卷而来。

lines.en: Of course, things are once again awkward between the two of us and I feel a sudden urge to speak out.
lines.zh: 当然，我俩之间又变得尴尬起来，而我突然有种想开口的冲动。

lines.en: The weird thing with Maya is that I’m not even sure if I should try breaking the ice in times like these or not.
lines.zh: 跟 Maya 之间有个奇怪的地方：这种时候我甚至不确定该不该试着打破僵局。

lines.en: I feel like more than half the time she just tells me to stop talking.
lines.zh: 我感觉一半以上的时间里，她只会叫我别说话。

lines.en: : Well...this is new.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这倒是新鲜。

lines.en: : Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya？

lines.en: scene vend2
: Oh, sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。

lines.en: : I must have stopped paying attention for a minute.
lines.zh: : 我刚才大概走神了一分钟。

lines.en: This is exactly what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: 我说的就是这个。

lines.en: One minute, everything seems fine between us...and the next, she’s pretending I don’t exist.
lines.zh: 前一刻我俩之间好像一切都还好……下一刻，她就开始假装我不存在。

lines.en: It doesn’t make any sense.
lines.zh: 这说不通。

lines.en: : I was just thinking that it feels a little weird being out here with you. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我刚才在想，跟你出来在这儿感觉有点怪。就这样。

lines.en: : But if you don’t want to talk, that’s fine. We can just stand here and relax for a while before heading back.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你不想说话，那也没关系。我们可以就在这儿站一会儿、放松一下，然后回去。

lines.en: scene vend1
: Right...
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : That would probably be for the best...
lines.zh: : 那样大概最好……

lines.en: And so the two of us stand there in silence, incapable of figuring out the best way to break the ever-growing glacier between us.
lines.zh: 于是我俩就这么沉默地站着，谁也想不出最好的办法，去敲碎我们之间那座不断增厚的冰山。

lines.en: I like Maya.
lines.zh: 我喜欢 Maya。

lines.en: I really do.
lines.zh: 我是真的喜欢。

lines.en: But at this rate, who’s to say if we’ll ever actually grow any closer?
lines.zh: 可照这样下去，谁说得准我们到底会不会真的更近一点？

lines.en: My relationship with her isn’t like the one I have with Yumi.
lines.zh: 我跟她的关系，跟我和 Yumi 的不一样。

lines.en: No matter how much time I spend with Maya, it seems like the way she looks at me doesn’t change at all.
lines.zh: 不管我花多少时间陪 Maya，她看我的眼神似乎都一点没变。

lines.en: It’s like she’s staring through me at times. Like I’m such an insignificant part of her life that it just...doesn’t even matter.
lines.zh: 有时候她简直像在透过我看。好像我在她生命里无足轻重到……根本无所谓。

lines.en: You’d think after resetting the entire world, the two of us might have bonded somewhat, but...
lines.zh: 你会以为，在重置了整个世界之后，我俩多少会有点羁绊，可是……

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I’m sure she’s reset the world countless times by now.
lines.zh: 我确信她到现在已经重置过这个世界无数次了。

lines.en: I’d be tired if I was her, too.
lines.zh: 换我是她，我也会累。

lines.en: So I’ll just...
lines.zh: 所以我还是……

lines.en: Finish this coffee and let her have a few moments to herself.
lines.zh: 把这杯咖啡喝完，让她自己安静一会儿吧。

lines.en: scene black
The walk back to the dorm isn’t as silent as the time we spent in the alley.
lines.zh: 回宿舍的路上，没有我们在巷子里时那么沉默。

lines.en: Maya mentions a few things about how Molly has been getting on her nerves lately and how she wants to trade her for another new student.
lines.zh: Maya 说了几件 Molly 最近怎么惹她烦的事，还说想拿她换另一个新生。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I don’t think I’m able to pull off a move like that, so Maya will need to suffer a little longer.
lines.zh: 可惜，我觉得那种操作我搞不来，所以 Maya 还得再忍一阵子。

lines.en: But we all must suffer in this life.
lines.zh: 不过这辈子我们都得受点苦。

lines.en: And no, I’m not talking about Molly anymore- I’m talking about life in general.
lines.zh: 而不，我现在说的不是 Molly——我说的是人生这东西本身。

lines.en: Sometimes, we’re completely incapable of dealing with the smallest things.
lines.zh: 有时候，我们连最小的事情都处理不了。

lines.en: Whether it be carrying boxes-
lines.zh: 不管是扛箱子——

lines.en: Or finding things to talk about in a random alleyway in the middle of the night-
lines.zh: 还是在半夜的某条小巷里找话题——

lines.en: This world is filled with confusion.
lines.zh: 这个世界充满了困惑。

lines.en: But it’s also filled with cute girls and the sensations that come along with violating them.
lines.zh: 但它也充满了可爱的女孩，以及侵犯她们时伴随的那些感觉。

lines.en: And so we must press on.
lines.zh: 所以我们必须前进。

lines.en: {s}THE FUTURE IS BRIGHT{/s}
lines.zh: {s}未来一片光明{/s}

lines.en: {s}CLOSE YOUR EYES{/s}
lines.zh: {s}闭上眼睛{/s}

lines.en: {s}TURN OFF THE LIGHTS{/s}
lines.zh: {s}关掉灯{/s}

lines.en: {s}DO EVERYTHING YOU CAN TO BRING THE DARKNESS BACK{/s}
lines.zh: {s}尽你一切所能，把黑暗找回来{/s}

lines.en: {s}Or prepare to be swallowed by it.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}否则就等着被它吞没。{/s}
